g.text: Routing decision of a channel (rules R1 to R7)
The replies of system processes bypass
the reducer. The R7 backend routes them with
these rules and no use context, so a forged
reply channel goes to the default space.
(P8 step 2): the bundle with both flags
around an agent-tagged tuple routes to its agent.
